t:
Arrange the legislations in chronological order of their dates (Starting from first).

I. Indian Factories Act
II. Indian Boilers Act
III. The Mines Act
e: Correct answer: II, I and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which among the following are principles applicable to all classes of engineering insurance?

I. Contribution
II. Reinsurance
III. Retrocession
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
The fundamental objective of 'Risk Management' is:

I. Improve liquidity
II. Preservation of earning power
III. Increase earning capacity
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Under a deterioration of stocks insurance (other than potatoes), the liability of the insurer is normally limited to the market value of commodities immediately before the accident. Argue. Choose the most appropriate option.
o: This statement is wrong as the liability of the in
e: Correct answer: This statement is right (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
The amount of the excess should be sufficient to:-

I. Eliminate the cost of repairing routine minor accidents.
II. Pay routine losses III. Avoid insurance claim payment
IV. Pay only losses smaller than premium
e: Correct answer: I, II, III and IV (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Under this form of reinsurance arrangements, the ceding company cedes the surplus in excess of its net retention and priority cessions like Quota Share Cession subject to an agreed maximum limit. Identify the type of reinsurance.
e: Correct answer: Surplus treaty (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
While calculating cost of replacement of a property under a CECR policy, which of the following costs should be included?

I. Cost of material
II. Cost of freight
III. Cost of wages
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
The sum insured under an Erection All Risk (EAR) policy can be adjusted based on the actual values of which of the following items?

I. Freight charges
II. Handling charges
III. Custom dues
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: ABC Industries have installed electric motors and generators in their factory. Which issues needs to be addressed to avoid failure of mechanical components of their electric motors and generators?
e: Correct answer: Misalignment (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following is a supplementary cover for a Contractor's Plant and Machinery (CPM) insurance policy?

I. Third party personal injury and property risks up to a limit
II. Loss or damage to the existing surrounding property
III. Additional basic customs duty
e: Correct answer: I&II (from the IC77 question bank).

t: What is the minimum capacity of a vessel to be termed as a boiler under the Indian Boilers Act 1923?
e: ★ Key fact (repeated across the mocks of this paper). Correct answer: 22.75 litres (from the IC77 question bank).

t: XYZ Ltd is electricity producing company. They have fitted  transformers. Which factor needs to be taken care the most to safe guard their transformers from failure?
o: Contamination of oil due to moisture and contaminants
e: Correct answer: Contamination of oil due to moisture and contaminants (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Normally, a Marine-cum Erection (MCE) Insurance Policy covers which of the following risks?

I. Damages due to improper packing
II. Damages due to nuclear weapons
III. Damage during testing and commissioning at site
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
The management of Crest Ltd., an engineering company wants to know, how long does the insurance cover last for the delay in start-up period of a CPI policy?

I. Begins on commencement of work on site and ceases on the date of commencement of operations
II. Begins on that date on which the insured property is put into commercial use and extends for a period of 12 months
III. Begins when fuel, raw materials or lubricants are first introduced, and ends on acceptance of the tests by the principal
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following types of insurances are available for protecting the financial impacts of any interruptions in the business?

I. Loss of profit insurance
II. Consequential loss insurance
III. Loss of earnings insurance
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following are covered under the Industrial All Risks Insurance (IAR) policy?

I. Machinery Break down insurance
II. Burglary insurance
III. Fire insurance
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following are special exclusions in a Comprehensive project (CP) insurance?

I. Construction of tunnels, galleries and underground structures
II. Normal action of the sea
III. Marine and off-shore work
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In a 'Hydrocarbon Endorsement For Testing & Commissioning' -Article 1, in any operation where hydrocarbons or hydrogen are involved the deductible excess shall be 5% of claim amount subject to minimum of _______.
e: ★ Key fact (repeated across the mocks of this paper). Correct answer: Rs5,00,000 (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following losses shall be covered under machinery insurance?

I. Physical damage to the machinery while at rest due to malfunctioning of control system
II. Physical damage due to atmospheric electricity
III. Damage due to explosion
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Normally, a Erection All Risk (EAR) Insurance Policy covers which of the following perils?

I. Tornado
II. Theft & Burglary
III. Defective materials
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following are examples of of construction phase policies?

I. Contractor's All Risks (CAR) insurance
II. Erection All Risks (EAR) insurance
III. Electronic Equipment insurance
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
The fundamental objective of 'Risk Management' is:

I. Preservation of assets
II. Preservation of earning power
III. Increase earning capacity
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Contractor's Plant and Machinery (CPM) insurance policy protects the insured against damages occurred to __________.

I. Construction plant and machinery
II. Constructed buildings
III. Ships and barges
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Erection All Risk (EAR) insurance does not provide cover during the maintenance period of a project automatically. Argue.
o: This statement is wrong as EAR insurance provides
This statement is wrong EAR insurance provides cov
e: Correct answer: This statement is right (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Treaty Reinsurance is also known as _________.
e: Correct answer: Automatic reinsurance (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In the Indian context, 10% of all direct Indian Engineering business, subject to a certain limit, is obligatorily ceded by all the Indian insurance companies to the ___________.
e: ★ Key fact (repeated across the mocks of this paper). Correct answer: GIC (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Unitech Limited is a construction company. It has taken a Comprehensive Project Insurance policy for all its sites. It has incurred the following losses at one of its sites. Which of the following losses shall be covered as per the CPI policy?

I. Damages due to mechanical break down of crane
II. Loss due to strike by workers
III. Theft of tools from the site
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Marine cum erection cover is the most comprehensive insurance cover for a project during the:

I. Feasibility period
II. Execution period
III. Maintenance period
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
In case of MLOP policies, a rough estimate of the interruption loss during early stages of breakdown or explosion claim needs to be made. This is generally done by:

I. Engineering surveyor
II. Chartered Accountant
III. Site engineer
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In a 'Hydrocarbon Endorsement For Testing & Commissioning' - Article 1, what is the maximum time frame permitted for carrying out cleaning and purging operations in each individual unit?
e: Correct answer: 2 weeks (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following are included as special insurance covers in a Comprehensive project (CP) insurance?

I. Extended defects liability period cover
II. Nuclear fuel elements
III. Costs of decontamination
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Nile is a shipping company and putting chemical pant. It has taken an Erection All Risk (EAR) insurance policy. It has incurred the following losses. Which of the following losses shall be covered in the EAR insurance policy?

I. Damages to ship due to tycoon
II. Damage of machinery of a ship
III. Damage to warehouse due to fire
o: None of I, II and III
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: For the purpose of the boiler and pressure plant insurance policy, explosions can be broadly classified as ___________ and ________.
e: Correct answer: Chemical explosions and Physical explosions (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Which of the following is one of the causes of the failure of mechanical components of electric motors and generators?
e: Correct answer: Lack of lubrication (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Device a term to describe the portion of loss that is borne by the insured in case of an event of claim.
e: Correct answer: Deductible (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Arrange the events in sequence. Starting from first to last.

I. Manchester Steam Users Association was founded
II. Steam Boiler Assurance Company was founded
III. Enactment of Indian Boilers Act
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following losses shall be covered under machinery insurance?

I. Physical damage to the machinery due to short circuit
II. Physical damage due to lack of skill
III. Damage due to collision
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: The principle that allows an insurer who has paid a claim to step into the insured's shoes and recover from a liable third party is:
e: ★ Core fact (asked across III papers). Subrogation is a corollary of indemnity; it does not apply to life or personal accident (benefit) policies.

t:
Which among the following risk are insurable by underwriters?

I. Trade risk due to economic reasons
II. Material damage caused due to natural perils
III. Risk due to human failures that lead to material damage in accidental failures
e: Correct answer: II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
From the option given below, suggest the correct use of compressors.

I. They used for conveying liquids and gases from one machine to another
II. For storage of steam, liquids and gases under pressure
III. They are used for reducing volume and increasing pressure of liquids and gases
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In CPM insurance, under which of the following conditions is an insured item regarded as totally destroyed?
o: If the value of one item or part thereof is increa
If the repair cost as described equals or exceeds its value immediately before the accident
If it is found that the sum insured is less than t
If the repair cost of one item of part thereof exc
If the item is beyond repair
e: Correct answer: If the repair cost as described equals or exceeds its value immediately before the accident (from the IC77 question bank).

t: During which stage of project planning, major work of land acquisition is done?
e: Correct answer: Site Preparation (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In a comprehensive project insurance policy, the details of 'the marine cargo insurance' are mentioned in which section?
e: Correct answer: Section 1B (from the IC77 question bank).

t: ___________ is a specific limit up to which the ceding company will bear all the losses on its net account.
e: Correct answer: Underlying limit (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Erection All Risk (EAR) policy provides cover for the entire project from ______________.

I. The time of arrival of material at site
II. Commencement of work
III. The date when the design is finalised which ever is earlier.
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In a life insurance contract, insurable interest must exist:
o: At the time of the claim only
Both at inception and at claim
e: ★ Core fact (asked across III papers). Life: at inception only. Marine: at the time of loss. Fire and motor: at both inception and loss.

t: In a deterioration of stock (Potatoes) in cold storage insurance policy, the cold store owner is also under an obligation to maintain a Log Book in which various recordings are made. What is the frequency of such recordings?
e: Correct answer: 4 hours (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Arrange the stages of a project in sequential order. Starting from first to last.

I. Call for tender
II. Feasibility studies
III. Award of contract
IV. Site activities
e: Correct answer: II, I, III and IV (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Identify the form of reinsurance arrangement from the following characteristics:

I. Ceding company offers each and every risk in excess of its own retention capacity for reinsurance
II. Reinsurer examines each risk according to its merit
III. This method is time consuming and administrative expense involved is very high
e: Correct answer: Facultative reinsurance (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Feasibility study of an infrastructure project addresses which of the following issues?

I. Size of the project, scope for future expansions
II. Selection of sites
III. Environmental and political reactions
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).
